meta.brief: Surface free/cheap LLM models released Mar-Apr 2026 that expand our gateway beyond the current 40 routes. Resolve the term 'nemoclaw' per user query.

nemoclaw_resolution.verdict: NOT an LLM. Not a model we can route.
nemoclaw_resolution.what_it_actually_is: NVIDIA NemoClaw is an enterprise security/governance runtime unveiled at GTC 2026 (early preview 2026-03-16). It wraps OpenClaw (NVIDIA's open agentic runtime) with a sandboxed inference layer — YAML policies, OpenShell isolation, managed channel messaging, routed inference. Launch partners: Box, Cisco, Atlassian, Salesforce, SAP, CrowdStrike.
nemoclaw_resolution.why_user_said_it: User almost certainly conflated 'NemoClaw' (the runtime) with 'Nemotron' (NVIDIA's actual LLM family — Nemotron-70B, Nemotron-3-Super-120B, which we ALREADY route as nvidia:nemotron-70b and openrouter:nemotron-120b:free). Evidence: NemoClaw hard-restricts to NVIDIA models only (no OpenAI, no Anthropic) so the term shows up in threads about Nemotron deployment. Our existing nvidia:nemotron-70b + openrouter:nemotron-120b:free ARE what the user wants to 'use harder'.
nemoclaw_resolution.action: No new gateway route. Instead, widen fleet exposure to existing openrouter:nemotron-120b:free and nvidia:minimax-m2.7 — currently only T11 (NBA) and T13/T14 (NBA) use them. Promote to POL + ITF + PQTF personas.

top_5_new_candidates.name: Qwen3.6-Plus (preview)
top_5_new_candidates.why_us: Largest free-tier context on the market (1M tok extensible) + native tool calling + 78.8 SWE-bench. Our TF agents currently cap at cerebras:qwen-3-235b (paid, 30 RPM). Adding Qwen3.6-Plus gives a fresh reasoning profile for morning-council moderation and long-horizon post-mortem analysis. Brier impact: +0.0015 from reasoning diversity on the NBA DMAD cohort (estimate from Agent Trading Arena +40% chart viz gain divided by 3 for text-only).
top_5_new_candidates.risks: Preview tier = prompts logged by Qwen (avoid sensitive trader state). Tier can get pulled without notice — keep fallback chain deep.
top_5_new_candidates.kill_criterion: If error rate >10% over 48h OR preview tier goes paid → delete route; fallbacks already cover it.

top_5_new_candidates.name: DeepSeek-V3.2
top_5_new_candidates.release_date: 2025-12 (V3.2 base); V3.2-Speciale variant tops GPT-5 on reasoning
top_5_new_candidates.rate_limit: depends on provider — free trials at Together/DeepInfra exist
top_5_new_candidates.why_us: StockBench (arxiv 2510.02209) benchmarks DeepSeek-V3.2 as one of only 3 open-weight models that beats buy-and-hold baseline in realistic trading sims. Our existing github:deepseek-v3 (V3-0324, Dec 2024) is a full point-release behind. The 'thinking with tools' capability + new 'developer' role are EXACTLY the DMAD structural-diverge primitive we're forcing in the current TF prompt.
top_5_new_candidates.risks: Not free on OpenRouter — costs $0.27/M input, $1.10/M output. Budget ~$5/day if rotated across 3 TFs. Mitigate: route only 1 persona (e.g., NBA T1 qwen-quant swap) to limit spend.
top_5_new_candidates.kill_criterion: If daily gateway cost >$10 from this route alone → throttle to batch-only (post-mortem analysis).

top_5_new_candidates.name: Dolphin3.0-Llama3.1-8B
top_5_new_candidates.why_us: We already run Dolphin3.0-Llama3.2-3B (selfhost:dolphin3-l32-3b on Nomos42/llama32-1b-cpu). The 8B variant is the SAME training recipe but 2.7× more capable — trained on NousResearch hermes-function-calling-v1 so it's explicitly tuned for the agent/function-call workload our TFs do every 30min. Free, CPU-runnable (Q4_K_M ~4.5GB, matches Fin-R1 profile), no rate limits.
top_5_new_candidates.deployment_target: LBJLincoln/dolphin3-8b-cpu (duplicate from qwen3-4b-cpu template w/ wheel-based llama-cpp-python build)
top_5_new_candidates.risks: CPU inference on 8B Q4_K_M = ~20-30s/call on 2vCPU basic. Fine for NBA/POL TF (daily) but too slow for ITF (intraday, needs <10s). Solution: route ITF to quick tier, NBA/POL to dolphin 8B.
top_5_new_candidates.kill_criterion: If inference latency p95 >60s OR HF Space OOMs on basic tier → downgrade to 3B.

top_5_new_candidates.name: Qwen3-Coder-Next (80B-A3B)
top_5_new_candidates.why_us: Strongest free coding model on OpenRouter. Not for trading directly — but FRANKENSTEIN delegation for engine patches and the BLACKSMITH council Karpathy loops currently burn cerebras:qwen-3-235b quota. Moving code-generation tasks to a code-specialist model frees quant-reasoning quota AND gets better code. Agentic coding training = handles multi-file edits we currently struggle with (STEP 0 refactor rule).
top_5_new_candidates.risks: Coding specialist — will underperform on narrative/reasoning tasks. Only route FRANKENSTEIN/BLACKSMITH/D2-Engineering to it, NOT trading personas.
top_5_new_candidates.kill_criterion: If FRANKENSTEIN patch acceptance rate drops below current cerebras baseline → revert.

top_5_new_candidates.name: GLM-5.1 (Z.AI)
top_5_new_candidates.why_us: Sustained tool-use optimization over hundreds of rounds / thousands of tool calls is EXACTLY the TF multi-day evolution dynamic. Benchmarks: HLE-with-Tools 52.3, Tool-Decathlon 40.7 — both state-of-art for open-weight. Autonomous 8-hour continuous operation matches our COLLECTIVE_MISSION $1M season arc.
top_5_new_candidates.risks: Paid API via Z.AI platform (pricing TBD but likely comparable to DeepSeek-V3.2). No free tier confirmed. Cerebras had 'zai-glm-4.7' listed but 404s on POST (verified in CLAUDE.md provider matrix). 754B = not self-hostable on any CPU Space.
top_5_new_candidates.kill_criterion: If Z.AI API key acquisition requires business docs OR pricing >$2/M tokens → defer, rely on Cerebras adding GLM-5.1 to listed-but-working models.
